hits.snippet: ## Share this article Share this article SAN FRANCISCO, Dec. 4, 2024 /PRNewswire/ -- HappyRobot, a pioneer in AI-powered voice solutions for the logistics sector, today announced it has secured $15.6 million in Series A funding. The round was led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), with participation from Y Combinator and strategic industry investors, including RyderVentures. This latest funding follows an earlier, previously undisclosed, pre-seed round raised 1.5 years ago, backed by Array Ventures and other angel investors. hits.snippet: HappyRobot has raised $44M in Series B funding to scale its AI agents for supply chain and operations. Founded in 2023 by Pablo Palafox, Luis Paarup, and Javi Palafox, the startup is building an AI workforce that automates the messy, repetitive workflows behind logistics, freight, customer support, and other high-volume industries. Unlike general-purpose copilots, HappyRobot’s agents are designed for production—handling end-to-end tasks like negotiating shipping rates, booking appointments, processing documents, collecting payments, and even recruiting staff. The platform integrates deeply with enterprise systems (TMS, ERP, CRM) and combines transcription, LLMs, voice, OCR, and browser automation.
